name: anlide/hilos-demo-binance-btc-tracker
description: Bitcoin price tracking with Binance demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.hilos-frontend-reminder: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL . 'Hilos frontend: run npm install in the frontend container after composer changes, so the vendored SDK is not stale - see framework/frontend/README.md.' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.setup-env: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-local sh -c "cd /hilos/demo/binance-btc-tracker && cp -n .env.example .env || true; cp -n tests/.env.example tests/.env || true; ls -l .env tests/.env"
scripts.install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local composer install
scripts.daemon-status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.db:migration:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:up
scripts.db:migration:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:down
scripts.db:migration:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:status
scripts.db:migration:retry: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:retry
scripts.db:seed:apply: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:seed:apply
scripts.db:schema:status: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.pma: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d binance-btc-tracker-phpmyadmin-local && echo phpMyAdmin is running at http://localhost:8119
scripts.frontend:install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-local npm install
scripts.frontend:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-local npm run check
scripts.frontend:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-local npm run build
scripts.test:install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test composer update phpunit/phpunit --no-interaction
test:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:logs:reset
scripts.test:db-reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:db-prepare: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test sh -c "php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:db:reset && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 25 && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:notification:seed 25 --read=3 && php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:notification:seed 501 --user=seed-002@example.test --delivered=email"
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite integration
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml
scripts.test:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-test sh -c "node ../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs && npm run check"
scripts.test:e2e-build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm binance-btc-tracker-frontend-cli-test sh -c "node ../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs && npm run build"
scripts.test:e2e-install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm binance-btc-tracker-e2e-runner node ../../../../framework/frontend/scripts/npm-install-if-stale.mjs
scripts.test:e2e-check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm binance-btc-tracker-e2e-runner npm run check
test:e2e-up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up -d --build binance-btc-tracker-daemon-test binance-btc-tracker-nginx-test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm binance-btc-tracker-e2e-runner npx playwright test
